questions.question: The number 726179 is divisible by which of the following?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Number = 726179

Divisors = 23, 29, 28, 20

**Formula Used:**

If a number is divisible by a divisor, then the remainder of the division is 0.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 726179 ÷ 23 = 31573, remainder = 0

⇒ 726179 ÷ 29 = 25040.65, remainder ≠ 0

⇒ 726179 ÷ 28 = 25935.68, remainder ≠ 0

⇒ 726179 ÷ 20 = 36308.95, remainder ≠ 0

**∴ The correct answer is 23.**

questions.question: ABCD is a quadrilateral such that ∠A = 47°, ∠B = 66°, ∠C = 133° and ∠D = 114°. What type of a quadrilateral is ABCD?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

∠A = 47°

∠B = 66°

∠C = 133°

∠D = 114°

**Formula Used:**

Sum of angles of a quadrilateral = 360°

A quadrilateral is cyclic if opposite angles sum to 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ ∠A + ∠C = 47° + 133° = 180°

⇒ ∠B + ∠D = 66° + 114° = 180°

Both pairs of opposite angles are supplementary.

**∴ ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral.**

questions.question: The LCM of 3³ × 9² × 1³, 3² × 13² × 1⁸ and 9³ × 13² × 18² is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

1) 3³ × 9² × 13

2) 3² × 13² × 18

**Formula Used:**

Convert composite numbers into prime powers.

LCM = product of all primes with their highest powers.

**Calculation:**

⇒ 9 = 3², 18 = 2 × 3²

**First number:**

3³ × (3²)² × 13 = 3³ × 3⁴ × 13 = 3⁷ × 13

**Second number:**

**Third number:**

(3²)³ × 13² × (2 × 3²)²

⇒ 3⁶ × 13² × 2² × 3⁴

⇒ 2² × 3¹⁰ × 13²

**Highest powers for LCM:**

2², 3¹⁰, 13²

**∴ LCM = 2² × 3¹⁰ × 13².**

L.C.M. = 4200

Other number = (Product of two numbers) / Given number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Product of two numbers = 33600

⇒ Other number = 33600 / 168

⇒ Other number = 200

**∴ The correct answer is 200.**

questions.question: A man driving a car at a speed of 48 km/hr crosses a bridge in 4.6 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 48 km/hr

Time = 4.6 minutes = 4.6 / 60 hours

**Formula Used:**

Length of bridge = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time = 4.6 / 60 = 0.07667 hours

⇒ Length of bridge = 48 × 0.07667

⇒ Length of bridge = 3.68 km

**∴ The correct answer is 3.68 km.**

questions.question: The product of two positive numbers is 2000. If the first number is five times the second number, then the sum of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Product of two positive numbers = 2000

&l
t;p>First number = 5 × Second number

**Formula Used:**

Let the second number be x, then the first number = 5x.

Product of two numbers = First number × Second number = 2000

Sum of two numbers = First number + Second number

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5x × x = 2000

⇒ 5x² = 2000

⇒ x² = 2000 / 5

⇒ x² = 400

⇒ x = √400

⇒ x = 20

First number = 5x = 5 × 20 = 100

Sum of two numbers = First number + Second number

⇒ Sum = 100 + 20

⇒ Sum = 120

**∴ The correct answer is 120.**

questions.question: Pipe P can fill (2)/(7) part of a tank in 18 hours, and pipe Q can fill (5)/(9) part of the same tank in 25 hours. Both P and Q were kept open for 3 hours, then both were closed. Pipe R alone was then opened and it emptied the water in the tank in 8 hours. Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipe P can fill (2)/(7) of the tank in 18 hours.

Pipe Q can fill (5)/(9) of the tank in 25 hours.

Pipes P and Q run for 3 hours, then Pipe R empties the water in 8 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Work done / Time taken

Time taken for full tank = Total work / Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Time taken by P to fill the whole tank

⇒ Time = dfrac{18 times 7}{2} = 63 hours

Time taken by Q to fill the whole tank

⇒ Time = dfrac{25 times 9}{5} = 45 hours

Efficiency of P, Q, R

Efficiency of P = (1)/(63)

Efficiency of Q = (1)/(45)

Work done by P + Q in 3 hours

⇒ Work = 3 × ((1)/(63) + (1)/(45))

⇒ Take LCM = 315

⇒ Work = 3 × (5 + 7)/(315) = (12)/(315)

⇒ Work = (36)/(315) = (12)/(105) = (4)/(35)

Pipe R empties this work in 8 hours

⇒ Efficiency of R = Emptying of (4)/(35) in 8 hours

⇒ Efficiency R = (-4)/(35 times 8) = (-1)/(70)

Combined efficiency of P + Q + R

Efficiency P = (1)/(63)

Efficiency Q = (1)/(45)

Efficiency R = (-1)/(70)

⇒ Combined efficiency = (1)/(63) + (1)/(45) - (1)/(70)

LCM = 630

⇒ Combined efficiency = (10 + 14 - 9)/(630) = (15)/(630) = (1)/(42)

Time taken to fill the tank when all run together

⇒ Time = (1)/(frac{1){42}} = 42 hours

**∴ Pipes P, Q and R together can fill the empty tank in 42 hours.**

questions.question: 86 light bulbs were purchased for ₹86, and 14 light bulbs broke in transit. The trader sold the remaining light bulbs at ₹3.20 each. Find his profit.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total bulbs purchased = 86

Total cost = 86

Broken bulbs = 14

Selling price per bulb = 3.20

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price per bulb = Total cost ÷ Total bulbs

Selling Price total = Number of bulbs sold × SP per bulb

Profit = Total SP − Total CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Cost price per bulb = 86 ÷ 86

⇒ Cost price per bulb = 1

⇒ Bulbs sold = 86 − 14

⇒ Bulbs sold = 72

⇒ Total selling price = 72 × 3.20

⇒ Total selling price = 230.40

⇒ Total cost price = 86

⇒ Profit = 230.40 − 86

⇒ Profit = 144.40

**∴ The profit is ₹144.40.**

questions.question: A trader claims to sell fruits at a profit of 22%, but also dishonestly uses a weight which is 4% less than what is mentioned on it. Find the total percentage of profit earned by the trader. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Claimed profit = 22%

Weight used = 4% less (i.e., trader gives only 96% of actual weight)

**Formula Used:**

;

Effective SP per actual kg = SP for 0.96 kg ÷ 0.96

Profit % = (Effective SP − CP) ÷ CP × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Assume CP of 1 kg = 100

⇒ Trader sells at 22% profit, so SP for 1 kg = 122

⇒ But he gives only 0.96 kg for the price of 1 kg

⇒ Effective SP per actual kg = 122 ÷ 0.96

⇒ Effective SP = 127.0833

⇒ Profit% = 127.0833 − 100

⇒ Profit% = 27.0833%

⇒ Rounded to nearest whole number = 27%

**∴ The total profit percentage is 27%.**

questions.question: The average weight of a family of five members whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 75 kg and 38 kg is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Weight of member 1 = 40 kg

Weight of member 2 = 49 kg

Weight of member 3 = 56 kg

Weight of member 4 = 75 kg

Weight of member 5 = 38 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average weight = (Sum of all weights) / (Number of members)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Sum of weights = 40 + 49 + 56 + 75 + 38

⇒ Sum of weights = 258 kg

⇒ Number of members = 5

⇒ Average weight = 258 / 5

⇒ Average weight = 51.6 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 51.6 kg.**

questions.question: In an election between two candidates, 82% of the registered voters cast their vote and 4% of the votes polled were found invalid. The winning candidate got 60% of the valid votes and won the election by a margin of 1968 votes. How many voters were registered?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let the total number of voters be 100 units.

⇒ Votes cast = 82% of 100 = 82 units

⇒ Invalid votes = 4% of 82 = 3.28 units

⇒ Valid votes = 82 − 3.28 = 78.72 units

Winner gets 60% of valid votes = 60% of 78.72 = 47.232 units

Loser gets 40% of valid votes = 40% of 78.72 = 31.488 units

Majority = 47.232 − 31.488 = 15.744 units

According to question:

15.744 units = 1968

⇒ 1 unit = 1968 ÷ 15.744 = 125

⇒ 100 units = 125 × 100 = 12,500

**∴ The number of registered voters is 12,500.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let the total number of registered voters be X.

⇒ Votes cast = 82% of X = 0.82X

⇒ Invalid votes = 4% of 0.82X = 0.0328X

⇒ Valid votes = 0.82X − 0.0328X = 0.7872X

Winner gets 60% and loser gets 40% of valid votes.

⇒ Majority = 20% of valid votes

⇒ 0.20 × (0.7872X) = 1968

⇒ 0.15744X = 1968

⇒ X = 1968 ÷ 0.15744

⇒ X = 12,500

**∴ The number of registered voters is 12,500.**

questions.question: The number of prime numbers lying between 332 and 343, both included, is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Range: 332 to 343 (both included)

**Formula Used:**

Check each number for divisibility to identify primes.

A prime number has only two factors: 1 and itself.

**Calculation:**

Check numbers one by one:

⇒ 332 (even, not prime)

⇒ 333 (divisible by 3, not prime)

⇒ 334 (even, not prime)

⇒ 335 (ends with 5, not prime)

⇒ 336 (even, not prime)

⇒ 337 (not divisible by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11 → prime)

⇒ 338 (even, not prime)

⇒ 339 (divisible by 3, not prime)

⇒ 340 (even, not prime)

⇒ 341 (341 = 11 × 31 → not prime)

⇒ 342 (even, not prime)

⇒ 343 (343 = 7 × 7 × 7 → not prime)

Only prime number found = 337

**∴ The number of prime numbers is 1.**

questions.question: A number, when increased by 60%, gives 3560. The number is:

⇒ Original number = 3560 / 1.6.

questions.question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 17 days and B can do the same job in 12 days. With the help of C, they did the job in 3 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 17 days

B can complete the work in 12 days

A + B + C together complete the work in 3 days

**Formula Used:**

Total work = LCM of individual times

Efficiency = Total work ÷ Time

C's efficiency = (A + B + C) − (A + B)

Time = Total work ÷ Efficiency

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 17 and 12 = 204 units (Total work)

⇒ A's 1-day work = 204 ÷ 17 = 12 units

⇒ B's 1-day work = 204 ÷ 12 = 17 units

⇒ A + B = 12 + 17 = 29 units per day

⇒ A + B + C = 204 ÷ 3 = 68 units per day

⇒ C's 1-day work = 68 − 29 = 39 units

⇒ Time taken by C = 204 ÷ 39

⇒ 204 ÷ 39 = 68 ÷ 13 = 5(3)/(13) days

**∴ C alone can do the job in 5(3)/(13) days.**

questions.question: Simplify: x(6x − 9) + 6(x² − 3) + 19
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x(6x − 9) + 6(x² − 3) + 19

**Formula Used:**

Distributive property: a(b + c) = ab + ac

Combine like terms.

**Calculation:**

⇒ x(6x − 9) = 6x² − 9x

⇒ 6(x² − 3) = 6x² − 18

⇒ Combine terms: 6x² − 9x + 6x² − 18 + 19

⇒ 12x² − 9x + 1

**∴ The correct answer is 12x² − 9x + 1.**

questions.question: Pooja, Harsh, and Madhur invest ₹1,120, ₹1,320, and ₹1,160, respectively to start a business. If the profit at the end of the year is ₹1,080, then what is the share of Madhur in the profit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pooja's investment = 1120

Harsh's investment = 1320

Madhur's investment = 1160

Total profit = 1080

**Formula Used:**

Profit share = (Individual investment ÷ Total investment) × Total profit

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total investment = 1120 + 1320 + 1160

⇒ Total investment = 3600

⇒ Madhur’s share = (1160 ÷ 3600) × 1080

⇒ Simplify 1160 ÷ 3600:

⇒ 1160 ÷ 3600 = 29 ÷ 90

⇒ Madhur’s share = (29 ÷ 90) × 1080

⇒ 1080 ÷ 90 = 12

&
lt;p>⇒ Madhur’s share = 29 × 12

⇒ Madhur’s share = 348

**∴ Madhur’s share in the profit is ₹348.**
